column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for the communication record. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the equipment. FK to Equipment.EQUIP_CODE.
TEXT. Reference to the location. FK to Location.STATION_name.
TEXT. GPS signal status. **NULL means no GPS signal data recorded.**. Possible values: Medium, Strong, Weak.
TEXT. Satellite connection status. **NULL means no satellite connection status recorded.**. Possible values: Connected, Disconnected, Limited.
REAL. Radio signal strength in dBm. Example: -97.8.
REAL. Radio frequency in MHz. Example: 731.2.
TEXT. Antenna status. Possible values: Error, Normal, Warning.
REAL. Network latency in milliseconds. Example: 1006.0.
REAL. Data rate in kilobits per second. Example: 389.6.
REAL. Wi-Fi signal strength in dBm. **NULL means no Wi-Fi signal data recorded.**. Example: -61.7.
TEXT. Bluetooth status. Possible values: Error, Off, On, Pairing.
BIGINT. Reference to the operation and maintenance record. FK to OperationMaintenance.OP_MAINT_ID.
